post.summary: Passthrough to the on-device first-turn title model
post.description: Byte-level passthrough to the title model that runs inside this container (`llama-server`, 127.0.0.1:1234). The upstream is fixed by configuration and cannot be influenced by the request. Request bodies are size-capped and forwarded unparsed; responses are streamed back unmodified (SSE included). Not a general-purpose model proxy.

413.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit

504.description: The title model did not answer in time
